# NewMouth

> NewMouth is a trusted resource for evidence-based dental health information, oral condition guides, and treatment recommendations across all age groups.

NewMouth provides comprehensive educational content on oral health conditions, dental procedures, and age-specific care guidelines. The site features expert-reviewed guides on common dental issues like cavities, gum disease, and oral cancer, alongside practical advice for maintaining dental health across different life stages.

## Key Topics

- Oral Health
- Gum Disease
- Dental Care
- Cavity Prevention
- Periodontal Disease
- Gingivitis
- Periodontitis
- Dental Treatment
- Family Dentistry
- Pediatric Dentistry
- Tooth Decay
- Oral Hygiene
- Fluoride
- General Dentistry
- Dental Health

## Oral Health Conditions & Prevention

- [Oral Health: Common Conditions, Diseases & Prevention Tips](https://www.newmouth.com/oral-health): Overview of oral health conditions including cavities, gum disease, and TMJ
- [Gum Disease: Causes, Prevention & Treatment](https://www.newmouth.com/oral-health/gum-disease): Comprehensive guide on gum disease causes, prevention, and treatment
- [Images and Early Signs of Cavities](https://www.newmouth.com/oral-health/what-do-cavities-look-like): Guide to identifying cavities with images and early warning signs
- [Oral Cancer (Mouth Cancer): Types, Causes & Treatment](https://www.newmouth.com/oral-health/oral-cancer): Educational guide on oral cancer types, causes, and treatment options
- [What is Temporomandibular Joint Dysfunction (TMD)?](https://www.newmouth.com/oral-health/tmj): Treatment guide for TMD symptoms, causes, and management options
- [Halitosis (Bad Breath): Causes, Treatment, and Prevention](https://www.newmouth.com/oral-health/halitosis): Guide to understanding halitosis causes, treatment, and prevention
- [Oral STDs - Symptoms, Causes, Prevention & Treatment](https://www.newmouth.com/oral-health/oral-stds): Educational guide on oral STDs, symptoms, prevention, and treatment

## Dental Care by Age Group

- [Babies Dental Care: Common Oral Conditions & Prevention](https://www.newmouth.com/dentistry/family/babies): Guide to baby dental care, teething, and cavity prevention
- [Dental Care for Children: Conditions, Treatment & Prevention](https://www.newmouth.com/dentistry/family/children): Guide to children's dental care, cavity prevention, and treatments
- [Dental Care for Teens: Oral Health Risks, Treatments & More](https://www.newmouth.com/dentistry/family/teens): Guide to teen dental care including orthodontics and hygiene
- [Adult Dental Care: Common Conditions & Treatments Options](https://www.newmouth.com/dentistry/family/adults): Guide to adult dental care, conditions, and treatment options

## General Dentistry Services

- [General Dentists: Common Services & Procedures](https://www.newmouth.com/dentistry/general): Overview of general dentistry services and common dental procedures
- [Sleep Apnea Disorders: Causes, Treatment Options & More](https://www.newmouth.com/dentistry/general/sleep-apnea): Medical guide on sleep apnea types, causes, and dental treatments

## Systemic Health & Oral Health Connections

- [How Your General Health Standing Impacts Your Oral Health](https://www.newmouth.com/oral-health/effects): Guide on how general health and lifestyle affect oral health
- [How Diabetes Impacts Your Oral Health Standing](https://www.newmouth.com/oral-health/effects/diabetes): Guide to diabetes impact on oral health and related dental conditions
- [Physical Disabilities & Oral Health](https://www.newmouth.com/oral-health/effects/physical-disabilities): Guide on oral health challenges and adaptations for physical disabilities

## Specialized Pediatric Topics

- [Cleft Lip and Palate: Causes, Risks & Treatment Timeline](https://www.newmouth.com/dentistry/pediatric/conditions/cleft-lip-and-palate): Treatment guide for cleft lip and palate causes and management

## Optional

- [NewMouth — Trusted Dental Health Information](https://www.newmouth.com): NewMouth homepage with expert dental health info and product reviews
- [How Many Teeth Do Humans Have? (Adults & Babies)](https://www.newmouth.com/blog/how-many-teeth): Article explaining tooth count in adults, babies, and wisdom teeth
- [Are Mouth Sores a Symptom of COVID-19?](https://www.newmouth.com/blog/oral-hygiene-covid19): Article on COVID-19 mouth sores symptoms and treatment options
